evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.scope_respected: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, git history, the diff and the plan were never opened.

identification_of_the_leaf.reasoning: The scenario name names two items: Black Cleaver and Bloodsong. Bloodsong (id 3877) is the only SUPPORT-tagged item in the pair, and it is the only item in the scenario whose effect emits a per-application debuff event on a champion target (Expose Weakness). 'support_events' therefore carries Bloodsong's Expose Weakness applications, and 'all_sources' is the flag stating whether the amplifier applies to damage from every source or only to damage dealt by the Bloodsong holder.
identification_of_the_leaf.cross_check: grep over the whole exported data/ tree for the literal token 'all_sources' returns zero hits, so the flag is engine-side vocabulary, not a cached field; its correct value must be read out of the cached wiki effect text.
identification_of_the_leaf.black_cleaver_excluded: Black Cleaver (id 3071) carries only 'Carve' (6% armor reduction per stack, up to 30% at 5) and 'Fervor' (20 bonus MS). Neither is a support event nor a damage-amplifier flag, so it cannot be the owner of this leaf.

independent_computation.step_1_read_cached_effect_text: data/items.json -> '3877' -> passives[0] (name 'Spellblade') -> branches[0], read via the passives[].branches contract (CLAUDE.md rule 6).
independent_computation.step_2_quoted_text: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

step_3_parse.scope_clause: 'increased damage FROM ALL SOURCES' -- the amplifier is a debuff on the target, not a buff on the Bloodsong holder, so every damage instance from any source (holder, allies, turrets, pets) is amplified while Expose Weakness is up.

independent_computation.step_4_conclusion: The scope clause is explicit and unconditional in the cached wiki text. A boolean flag named 'all_sources' on an Expose Weakness event must therefore be true. An absent flag either (a) reads as false / holder-only under any sane default, which contradicts the wiki text, or (b) leaves the scope unrecorded, which under-specifies the event. Emitting all_sources = true is the value the source text supports.
independent_computation.corroboration: The same 'from all sources' wording is used by the other cached amplifier debuffs that are known to be source-agnostic -- Imperial Mandate (4005) 'marks them as Vulnerable for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%' and Abyssal Mask (8020) 'causing them to receive 12% increased magic damage from all sources'. The phrase is the wiki's consistent marker for a target-side, all-attacker amplifier, which confirms the reading rather than being an isolated turn of phrase. Contrast with holder-side amps that lack the phrase, e.g. Riftmaker (4633) 'deal 2% increased damage' and Spear of Shojin (3161), which amplify only the wearer's own damage.

sources_quoted.relevance: The only mention of either scenario item in math-foundations.md. It governs Black Cleaver stack averaging and says nothing about support events or damage-amplifier scope, so it neither supports nor contradicts this leaf; the wiki text is the sole controlling source.

caveats: The exported tree contains no scenario definition for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' (grep for the scenario name across data/ returns nothing), so support_events[17] could not be resolved to a specific timestamp or actor. The identification rests on Bloodsong being the scenario's only support item and the only one whose cached text carries a target-side amplifier.
The magnitude of the amplifier (8% melee / 5% ranged) is not the subject of this leaf and was not audited; only the source-scope boolean was computed.
